svg.title: Solder bridging / short circuit: potential causes
svg.desc: Training analysis. Source branch order and causal arrows preserved. Top branches left to right: Environment, People, Materials. Bottom branches left to right: Methods, Equipment. Potential causes are hypotheses for investigation.
